articles.summary: NEW YORK, Sept. 02, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- INNOVATE CORP.® (NYSE: VATE) (“INNOVATE” or the “Company”) announced today the successful closing of the previously announced transaction between INNOVATE and CONX Corp. (“CONX”), pursuant to which CONX acquired a controlling interest in HC2 Broadcasting
articles.title: INNOVATE Announces Closing of the Sale of a Controlling Interest in its Broadcasting Segment to CONX
